label: Indicative, not a valuation. Check with a quantity surveyor, valuer and your accountant.

statusKey.VERIFIED_REPORT: A figure read from a published page or report this session
statusKey.VERIFIED_SECONDARY: Read from a secondary page that reproduces an official rate
statusKey.ESTIMATE: Analyst judgement, anchored to the evidence named in the row

NSW.name: NSW transfer duty
NSW.note: Scale for contracts from 01/07/2025. Thresholds are indexed each 01/07, so the current scale may differ slightly. Premium property duty and concessions are not modelled.

QLD.name: Queensland transfer duty (general rates, no home concession)
QLD.note: Read from a secondary page that reproduces the Queensland Revenue Office general rates. Concessions and the first home and vacant land concessions are not modelled.

gst.note: Indicative. The margin scheme needs the land to have been acquired in a way that allows it, and an agreement with the buyer. Confirm with your accountant.

legalPct.label: Legal, searches and due diligence
legalPct.source: Analyst allowance for conveyancing, searches and a valuation. No published scale.

ratesPct.label: Council and water rates on the land
ratesPct.source: Analyst allowance, regional council rates on vacant land. Check the current rates notice.

insurancePct.label: Site and contract works insurance
insurancePct.source: Analyst allowance. Get a broker quote.

daFeePct.label: DA or application fee
daFeePct.source: Analyst allowance, council fee scales are a small percentage of the cost of works. Check the council fee schedule.

lcrPct.label: Loan to cost ratio
lcrPct.source: https://www.feasly.com.au/guides/construction-finance-property-developers-australia (60 to 80 per cent of total development cost)

ratePct.label: Interest rate
ratePct.source: https://www.feasly.com.au/guides/construction-finance-property-developers-australia (non-bank construction facility 8.00 to 11.95 per cent); RBA cash rate 4.85 per cent from 03/11/2026

feePct.label: Loan establishment fee
feePct.source: https://www.feasly.com.au/guides/construction-finance-property-developers-australia (1 to 2 per cent of the facility)

targetMarginPct.label: Target margin on cost
targetMarginPct.source: Common lender and developer hurdle, used for the residual land value. Set your own.

approvalsFixed.label: Approvals reports (survey, geotech, traffic, flood, stormwater)
approvalsFixed.source: Analyst allowance for a small regional commercial DA. Get consultant quotes.

approvalMonths.label: Design and approvals
approvalMonths.source: Analyst allowance. Land is held and interest accrues on the land loan.

buildMonths.label: Construction
buildMonths.source: Analyst allowance for a small shed or strata unit complex.

tailMonths.label: Sell down or lease up
tailMonths.source: Analyst allowance. Interest runs until the units settle or the lease is signed.

agentPct.label: Agent commission
agentPct.source: market.json softCosts (selling 1.5 to 2.5 per cent, agent and marketing). No commercial scale found.

marketingPct.label: Marketing
marketingPct.source: market.json softCosts (selling 1.5 to 2.5 per cent, agent and marketing).

leasingMonths.label: Leasing commission
leasingMonths.source: market.json softCosts (leasing 1 to 2 months of gross rent). No published scale.

vacancyPct.label: Vacancy allowance
vacancyPct.source: Analyst allowance, see the vacancy notes in market.json.

cutRate.label: Cut and haul rate
cutRate.source: Analyst allowance. Get an earthworks quote.

fillRate.label: Imported or compacted fill rate
fillRate.source: Analyst allowance. Get an earthworks quote.

professionalPct.label: Design and professional fees
professionalPct.source: Analyst allowance for design, engineering, certification and survey on a house.

contPct.label: Contingency
contPct.source: Analyst allowance, aligned with the commercial contingency range.

approvalsFixed.label: Approvals reports (survey, geotech, BASIX or energy, bushfire)

buildMonths.label: Construction
buildMonths.source: Analyst allowance for a single house.

agentPct.label: Agent commission
agentPct.source: Typical regional residential commission range. Agents set their own rate.

outgoingsPct.label: Outgoings (rates, insurance, management, repairs)
outgoingsPct.source: Analyst allowance for a house let on a residential lease.

capRatePct.label: Net yield for the hold value
capRatePct.source: Gross yield 4.6 per cent less outgoings. Analyst allowance, check a local agent rental appraisal.

grossYieldPct.label: Gross rental yield
grossYieldPct.source: Analyst allowance for regional NSW and Queensland houses. Check a local agent rental appraisal.

pavingRate.label: Driveway and paving
pavingRate.source: Analyst allowance for concrete or asphalt paving.

servicesLump.label: Services connections (water, sewer, power, stormwater)
servicesLump.source: Analyst allowance. Get plumber, electrician and council quotes.

prepRate.label: Site preparation and slab pad
prepRate.source: Analyst allowance. Depends on slope and soil, get a geotechnical and quote.

cutRate.label: Cut and haul rate
cutRate.source: Analyst allowance. Get an earthworks quote.

fillRate.label: Imported or compacted fill rate
fillRate.source: Analyst allowance. Get an earthworks quote.

NSW.source: Analyst allowance for s7.11 or s7.12 plus water and sewer headworks in regional NSW. Not read from a council plan this session. Confirm with council.

QLD.source: Analyst allowance anchored to the order of the Queensland prescribed infrastructure charge for a 3 or more bedroom dwelling. Not read this session. Confirm with council.

build.unit: $ per m2 of floor area, ex GST, whole house cost (build and fit out)
build.source: https://www.aussie.com.au/insights/articles/costs-of-building-a-house/ (build cost per m2 by tier, 2025-26 data; regional NSW 2,200 to 3,200)
build.note: The value is the middle of each published range. Regional NSW is quoted at 2,200 to 3,200 per m2, so the regional factor stays at 1.00 until a quantity surveyor says otherwise.

budget.note: Value of a new budget home against the median existing dwelling. Analyst factor.

standard.note: New mid range home at about the median existing dwelling value. Analyst factor.

premium.note: Premium finish and larger floor area. Analyst factor.

landShareOfValue.source: Analyst allowance, the land share of a regional dwelling value for a 600 m2 lot. Use the actual lot price when known.

residential.areaSource: https://discover.cotality.com/hubfs/441896203/Gated-Content/Regional-Report-May-2026.pdf (Summary of all SUAs dwellings, values, data to April 2026). Median dwelling value for the urban area, houses and units together.

NSW.label: Regional NSW default
NSW.note: Middle of the regional NSW urban areas above (Armidale, Dubbo, Orange, Tamworth, Wagga Wagga).

QLD.label: Regional QLD default
QLD.note: Middle of the regional QLD urban areas above (Bundaberg, Cairns, Mackay, Rockhampton, Toowoomba, Townsville).

commercialTypes.note: Factors against the area's strata unit rates (market.json and the portal evidence). Where market.json has an area figure for showroom, office or retail rent, that figure is used instead of the factor. These are analyst factors anchored to the area rows and the yield tiers in market.json yieldMethod. Not published type rates.

warehouse.label: Warehouse or large shed
warehouse.note: Larger buildings sell for less per m2 than small strata units, as in market.json.

showroom.label: Showroom
showroom.note: Sale rate is the capitalised net rent.

office.label: Office
office.note: Sale rate is the capitalised net rent.

retail.label: Retail
retail.note: Sale rate is the capitalised net rent.

service-station.label: Service station
service-station.note: Usually valued on the site and the lease, not on floor area. Sale rate is the capitalised net rent. Get a valuer opinion.
